title: Planning Width Is Hard to Approximate Even Given the Unique Optimal Plan
abstract: arXiv:2611.25484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For each fixed $k$, iterative-width search finds optimal plans in polynomial time on tasks of bounded tuple-chain width, but the approximability of planning width has remained open even when an optimal plan is supplied. When all optimal plans visit the same state sequence, we characterize set and chain width as hitting numbers of competing states. We construct positive-precondition STRIPS tasks with a supplied unique optimal plan, a single reachable goal state, binary branching, and constant-size actions. Every reachable state lies on a goal-reaching execution at most one action longer than optimal, yet distinguishing width $1$ from $\Theta(N)$, where $N$ is the number of atoms, is NP-hard for set, chain, and goal-admissible width. Unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$, no polynomial-time algorithm achieves a one-sided approximation factor $o(N)$ or a symmetric factor $o(\sqrt{N})$, and simple estimates attain both orders. For positive-preco

translated_title: 即使给定唯一最优计划，规划宽度仍然难以近似
translated_abstract: 对于每个固定的 $k$，迭代宽度搜索能够在元组链宽度有界的任务上以多项式时间找到最优计划，但即使在已提供最优计划的情况下，规划宽度的可近似性也一直是悬而未决的问题。当所有最优计划访问相同的状态序列时，我们将集合宽度和链宽度刻画为竞争状态的命中数（hitting numbers）。我们构造了一类正前提条件的 STRIPS 任务，它们具有给定的唯一最优计划、单一可达目标状态、二叉分支结构以及常量大小的动作。每个可达状态都位于一条到达目标且最多比最优计划多一个动作的执行路径上，然而对于集合宽度、链宽度和目标可采纳宽度而言，区分宽度 $1$ 与 $\Theta(N)$（其中 $N$ 为原子数量）是 NP 难的。除非 $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$，否则不存在多项式时间算法能够实现单边近似因子 $o(N)$ 或对称近似因子 $o(\sqrt{N})$，而简单的估计方法即可达到这两个量级。
tldr: 该论文证明即使在提供了唯一最优计划的情况下，区分规划宽度为 1 与 Θ(N) 依然是 NP 难的，因此除非 P=NP，规划宽度不存在具有有效近似因子的多项式时间近似算法。
en_tdlr: Even when the unique optimal plan is supplied, distinguishing planning width 1 from Θ(N) is NP-hard, so unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can approximate planning width within a one-sided factor o(N) or a symmetric factor o(√N).
